basic_info.description: Beautiful Sunset Home + Cottage with Coastal Charm, offering the perfect blend of modern comfort and beachy charm, just 2 blocks from the Great Highway Park & Ocean Beach. 3 spacious bdrms, including a tranquil primary suite & 2 bathrooms with stylish, high-end finishes & Toto toilets. To-the-studs remodel incl new electrical & plumbing, NEST and tankless water heater. The heart of the home is the gorgeous eat-in kitchen, thoughtfully remodeled with sleek cabinetry, stainless steel appliances incl Thermadore gas range, perfect for both everyday meals and entertaining guests. A cozy media/family room on the lower level provides additional living space, along with an office area for those who work from home. Step outside to discover your own private oasis; a large, landscaped yard perfect for outdoor relaxation and entertaining. The charming hobby shed/art cottage adds an extra layer of appeal, whether you're looking for a creative studio, workspace, or simply a serene retreat. Parking and W/D in large garage. Prime location just a short stroll to the beach and close proximity to parks, public transit, and local cafes,this Outer Sunset gem offers a rare opportunity to live in one of San Francisco's most desirable neighborhoods.A perfect blend of comfort, style & coastal living.
